releases.legal_basis: Informed Patient consent to permit the receipt, processing and release of data by the HSCIC

texts.2312220bee78:
The DELBYA study is a study of young adults that aims to identify factors that influence the diversity in lung function and birth weight among different ethnic groups and aims to explain this diversity.
During the DELBYA study lung function, height and weight, pulse and blood pressure were measured. Participants also completed questionnaires related to their general and respiratory health.  
The data collection for the project is complete aside from collecting birth weight for the participants.
The requested birth weight data will be linked with the data already obtained in the DELBYA study to explain the difference in lung function among participants of different ethnic groups.
